## What it is

This project examined tuition, demographic, and institutional data from
2011-2021 to study the drivers of rising college costs. The objective was to
build a reproducible analysis that could support both technical and
non-technical audiences.

## What I did

- Cleaned and modeled multi-year tuition and demographic datasets in R.
- Analyzed relationships between living arrangements and tuition-related costs.
- Produced a reproducible RMarkdown report with visuals and interpretation.

## Outcome

The project identified steady annual living-cost increases and estimated that
students living off-campus with family could save approximately $13,000 per
year compared to on-campus housing.
